gloss: ease of use; feel (of using something); user experience

definitions.gloss: ease of use; how something feels to use
definitions.explanation: The quality of comfort and satisfaction experienced when using a product or tool.

examples.japanese: このペンは{使|つか}い{心地|ごこち}がいい。
examples.english: This pen feels nice to use.

examples.japanese: {使|つか}い{心地|ごこち}の{良|よ}いキーボードを{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a comfortable keyboard to use.

examples.japanese: この{化粧品|けしょうひん}は{使|つか}い{心地|ごこち}が{滑|なめ}らかだ。
examples.english: This cosmetic has a smooth feel when applied.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{使|つか}う (to use) + {心地|ここち} (feeling, sensation) → feeling while using

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{使|つか}い{心地|ごこち}がいい / {良|よ}い (easy/pleasant to use)
・{使|つか}い{心地|ごこち}が{悪|わる}い (unpleasant to use)
・{使|つか}い{心地|ごこち}{抜群|ばつぐん} (exceptional usability)

RELATED ～{心地|ごこち} WORDS:
・{居心地|いごこち} (comfort of a place)
・{乗|の}り{心地|ごこち} (ride comfort)
・{着心地|きごこち} (wearing comfort)
・{寝心地|ねごこち} (sleeping comfort)

USAGE NOTE:
Broad application: can describe the feel of tools, electronics, cosmetics, apps, etc. Common in product reviews.
